items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Sarah Vaughan, she can sing the blues, but she scat too much for me. Got a nice voice, though.

ctx.x: Well, who were some of your favorite blues singers, as long as we're on the subject?

My favorite blues singers? Well, the ones that came to the Palace Theatre in Memphis, when my aunt would take me. Ma Rainey, back in those days, Bessie Smith -- I read Bessie Smith had a gigantic sound as a singer.

Oh, yeah. Bessie Smith, Ida Cox, Baby Cox and all -- Bessie Smith, oh, yeah, she was a blues stomper. Those were the original blues singers. And on and off, Bessie was one of the tops. Ida Cox, and here there's one I heard the other night. It was on Dinah's show, Dinah Washington's show. Now, Dinah Washington can sing, also, the blues. Sarah Vaughan, she can sing the blues, but she scat too much for me. Got a nice voice, though. Billie Holiday could sing the blues.
